name: ChatGPT
desc: OpenAI 的通用对话助手，GPT 系列模型，生态最全。
caveat: 国内访问要自备方式，且价格在第一梯队。如果只是日常问答，国产免费版本已经够用，没必要为它额外折腾。
descEn: OpenAI's flagship assistant. The most balanced all-rounder, with the largest third-party ecosystem.
caveatEn: Needs a workaround to access from mainland China, and it sits in the top price tier. For everyday Q&A, free Chinese models are already enough — don't go to the trouble unless you need it.

name: Claude
desc: Anthropic 出品，长文本与代码能力突出，Artifacts 可实时预览。
caveat: 安全策略偏保守，「写一封强硬的催款邮件」这类正常商业请求可能被软化。国内同样需要自备访问方式。
descEn: Anthropic's assistant. Excellent at long documents and code, and widely considered the most natural prose stylist.
caveatEn: Its safety policy is conservative — a normal business request like writing a firm payment reminder may get softened. Access from mainland China also needs a workaround.

name: Gemini
desc: Google 多模态助手，深度整合搜索与 Workspace。
caveat: 产品线版本极多，同一个入口进去拿到的可能是完全不同档位的模型，选型时要看清具体型号。
descEn: Google's assistant. Native multimodal with video understanding, tightly integrated with Search and Workspace.
caveatEn: The product line is sprawling — the same entry point can hand you a completely different tier of model. Check the exact model name before committing.

name: DeepSeek
desc: 国产开源强模型，推理与代码性价比极高。
caveat: 高峰期响应会明显变慢，做实时交互类产品前先压测。安全对齐相对宽松，面向公众时要自己加一层护栏。
descEn: Chinese reasoning-focused models. Strong at maths and code, with API pricing far below the international flagships.
caveatEn: Response times slow noticeably at peak hours — load-test before building a real-time product. Safety alignment is also loose, so add your own guardrails for public-facing use.

name: Kimi
desc: 月之暗面出品，超长上下文与文件解析见长。
caveat: 长上下文是主打，但再长的窗口也存在「中间段落召回下降」，关键信息尽量放开头或结尾。
descEn: Moonshot AI's assistant, built around a very long context window and good file/web reading.
caveatEn: Long context is the headline, but recall still drops for content buried in the middle. Put key information at the start or end of your prompt.

name: 豆包
desc: 字节跳动 AI 助手，语音与多模态体验好。
caveat: 消费端产品能力比 API 开放度更高，做开发前先确认你要用的能力在 API 里有没有。
descEn: ByteDance's assistant. Extremely cheap API, strong voice interaction, a complete multimodal product line.
caveatEn: The consumer app is more capable than the API. Before building on it, confirm the specific capability you need is actually exposed.

name: 通义千问
desc: 阿里 Qwen 家族，开源系列覆盖多个尺寸。
caveat: 同一家族不同尺寸版本能力差距很大，别拿小尺寸的测试结果推断旗舰版表现。
descEn: Alibaba's model family. The widest size coverage — from on-device to flagship — with solid Chinese and a permissive Apache licence.
caveatEn: Capability varies a lot between sizes. Don't extrapolate from a small model's test results to infer how the flagship performs.

name: Grok
desc: xAI 出品，实时接入 X 平台信息。
caveat: 内容审核策略宽松，输出需要自己过滤——这既是优点也是风险，面向 C 端要格外注意。
descEn: xAI's assistant with real-time access to social platform data. Some versions ship open weights.
caveatEn: Content moderation is loose — useful in some cases, risky in others. Filter the output yourself if you're building anything public.

name: Microsoft Copilot
desc: 微软全家桶 AI，深度嵌入 Windows 与 Office。
caveat: 深度绑定微软生态，脱离 Office / Windows / Azure 之后优势会大打折扣。
descEn: Microsoft's assistant, embedded across Windows, Office and Azure.
caveatEn: Its value is mostly in Microsoft's ecosystem. Outside Office/Windows/Azure the advantage largely disappears.

name: Le Chat
desc: Mistral 官方助手，响应快、欧洲合规。
caveat: 中文语感明显弱于国产模型，且国内访问不稳。选它通常是冲着欧洲合规而不是能力。
descEn: Mistral's assistant. Fast, efficient, and built with European compliance requirements in mind.
caveatEn: Chinese language quality lags noticeably behind domestic models, and access from China is unstable. People usually pick it for compliance, not capability.

name: 智谱清言
desc: 智谱 GLM 系列官方对话产品。
caveat: 生态体量小于头部厂商，第三方教程和踩坑记录少，遇到问题更依赖官方文档。
descEn: Zhipu AI's models. Solid tool calling among Chinese providers, with open-weight versions you can self-host.
caveatEn: The ecosystem is smaller than the major labs', so third-party tutorials and troubleshooting notes are scarce — you'll rely more on official docs.

name: 海螺 AI
desc: MiniMax 出品，对话 + 语音 + 视频一条龙。
caveat: 通用对话不是它的强项，选它通常是为了语音或视频，别在文本任务上做主力。
descEn: MiniMax's assistant, spanning text, speech and video in one family.
caveatEn: General chat isn't its strength. People choose MiniMax for voice or video — don't make it your primary text model.

name: Cursor
desc: AI 优先的代码编辑器，代码库级理解与自动改写。
caveat: 按订阅收费，重度使用成本不低；且它对项目结构的依赖很强，代码库越乱效果越差。
descEn: An AI-native code editor built on VS Code. Best-in-class at multi-file edits driven by natural language.
caveatEn: Subscription pricing adds up under heavy use, and it leans hard on your project's structure — the messier the codebase, the worse the results.

name: Claude Code
desc: 终端里的编程智能体，能读代码、跑命令、改多文件。
caveat: 命令行工作流，不习惯终端的人上手成本高。改动范围大时需要配合 git 才能安全回滚。
descEn: Anthropic's command-line coding agent that reads your repo, runs commands and iterates on failures.
caveatEn: A terminal-first workflow; people who don't live in a shell will find the ramp steep. Large changes need git discipline to stay safe.

name: GitHub Copilot
desc: 最普及的代码补全，已扩展为多模型智能体。
caveat: 补全体验最好，但「按需求改多个文件」这类跨文件任务，能力弱于专门的 AI IDE。
descEn: GitHub's AI pair programmer. The most polished inline completion experience available.
caveatEn: Best at completion. For cross-file tasks like 'implement this across the project', dedicated AI IDEs are stronger.

name: Windsurf
desc: 以 Cascade 为核心的 Agentic IDE。
caveat: 已被 Cognition（Devin 的公司）收购，产品线正在并入 Devin。选它之前先确认官方目前把编辑器放在什么位置——接受一家刚被收购的产品做长期投入要谨慎。
descEn: An agentic IDE with a well-designed flow between you and the AI.
caveatEn: Its editor ecosystem and plugin compatibility lag VS Code — heavy users of specific extensions will feel the gap.

name: Trae
desc: 字节出品的 AI IDE，中文体验友好。
caveat: 国内可直连是优势，但底层模型可选项少于国际同类产品。
descEn: ByteDance's AI IDE, directly accessible from mainland China.
caveatEn: Direct access is the selling point, but you get fewer underlying model choices than international alternatives.

name: v0
desc: 一句话生成可用的 React / Tailwind 界面。
caveat: 只擅长前端界面生成，且产出偏「原型级」——接入真实业务逻辑后往往要大量改造。
descEn: Vercel's tool for generating UI from prompts or screenshots. Excellent at producing presentable interfaces fast.
caveatEn: Frontend-only, and the output is prototype-grade — wiring in real business logic usually means substantial rework.

name: Bolt.new
desc: 浏览器里直接生成并部署全栈应用。
caveat: 一键出应用很爽，但生成的项目结构和依赖选择不一定符合你的工程规范。
descEn: StackBlitz's tool for generating and running full-stack apps in the browser from a prompt.
caveatEn: Generating an app in one shot is satisfying, but the project structure and dependencies it picks may not match your engineering standards.

name: OpenAI Codex
desc: OpenAI 的云端软件工程智能体。
caveat: 偏云端异步任务模式，需要把上下文交给它，对私有代码库慎用。
descEn: OpenAI's cloud-based coding agent that works asynchronously on delegated tasks.
caveatEn: It works asynchronously in the cloud, which means handing over context. Think twice for private codebases.

name: Replit
desc: 在线 IDE + Agent，边聊边把应用做出来。
caveat: 在线环境方便但性能和本地 IDE 差距明显，长期工程还是搬回本地更实际。
descEn: A browser-based IDE with an integrated AI agent that can build and deploy from a description.
caveatEn: Convenient online, but performance lags a local setup. For long-term engineering, moving back to a local IDE is more realistic.

name: Qoder
desc: 阿里推出的 Agentic 编程平台。
caveat: 较新的产品，生态和文档积累有限，关键项目建议先小范围试点。
descEn: An agentic coding tool from Alibaba, focused on repository-level understanding.
caveatEn: A relatively new product with limited ecosystem and documentation. Pilot it on something non-critical first.

name: Midjourney
desc: 美学标杆的文生图工具，出图质感强。
caveat: 精确控制能力弱——「把左边那棵树的颜色改成深绿」这类指令它做不到。需要精确改图请换工具。
descEn: The aesthetic benchmark for AI image generation, with mature style-consistency tooling.
caveatEn: Precise control is its weak spot — instructions like 'make the tree on the left dark green' simply don't work. Switch tools when you need exact edits.

name: GPT Image
desc: OpenAI 图像模型，指令遵循与文字渲染好。
caveat: 审美偏保守，艺术性和氛围感不如 Midjourney；价格也属于高位。
descEn: OpenAI's image model. The most accurate at following instructions and rendering legible text inside images.
caveatEn: Its aesthetic is conservative — less artistic atmosphere than Midjourney — and it sits in the top price tier.

name: Nano Banana
desc: Gemini 图像编辑模型，一致性改图出圈。
caveat: 主要通过对话产品使用，批量生成和 API 调用能力受限，不适合大规模生产。
descEn: Google's image model, outstanding at character and object consistency, with a conversational editing flow.
caveatEn: Primarily used through the chat product, so batch generation and API access are limited. Unsuitable for large-scale production.

name: FLUX
desc: Black Forest Labs 开源图像模型，可自部署。
caveat: 显存门槛高，且需要自己搭工作流。想要开箱即用请选云端产品。
descEn: An open image model from Black Forest Labs with leading quality for open weights.
caveatEn: High VRAM requirements and you have to build your own workflow. If you want something that just works, choose a cloud service.

name: ComfyUI
desc: 节点式图像生成工作流，自由度最高。
caveat: 节点式工作流学习曲线陡，只做出图不动配置的人会被它的复杂度劝退。
descEn: A node-based image generation workflow tool. The most flexible and controllable option available.
caveatEn: The node graph has a steep learning curve. People who just want to generate images will be put off by the complexity.

name: 即梦 AI
desc: 剪映系图像视频生成，中文提示词友好。
caveat: 风格库偏商业设计，做纯艺术探索时选择面较窄。
descEn: ByteDance's image tool. Strong Chinese prompt understanding, excellent text rendering and poster layout.
caveatEn: The style library skews commercial design, so it's narrow for pure artistic exploration.

name: Ideogram
desc: 文字排版与海报类图像生成见长。
caveat: 强项只在图内文字排版，画面质感和风格多样性不是它的优势。
descEn: Distinctive at typography and text layout inside images.
caveatEn: Its strength is text rendering only. Image quality and style variety are not where it wins.

name: Recraft
desc: 面向设计的生成工具，可出矢量图。
caveat: 矢量与品牌风格一致性是卖点，但写实类图像质量一般。
descEn: Vector output and brand-consistent styles. Popular for design assets that need to scale.
caveatEn: Vector and brand consistency are the draw, but photorealistic quality is average.

name: Krea
desc: 实时生成与增强，交互式创作体验。
caveat: 实时生成体验好，但精细度和可控性弱于专业出图工具。
descEn: Real-time image generation with a strong interactive feel.
caveatEn: Great real-time experience, but precision and controllability trail professional image tools.

name: Sora
desc: OpenAI 视频生成模型，物理一致性领先。
caveat: 额度与价格都在高位，且国内访问不便。做批量短视频的话成本会失控。
descEn: OpenAI's video model. Leading physical consistency and long-shot coherence.
caveatEn: Quota and pricing are both at the high end, and access from China is awkward. Batch short-video production gets expensive fast.

name: 可灵 Kling
desc: 快手视频生成，人物动作自然。
caveat: 高峰期排队较长，做需要即时产出的工作流要留出等待时间。
descEn: Kuaishou's video model. Natural, fluid human motion and excellent image-to-video, directly accessible in China.
caveatEn: Long queues at peak times. If your workflow needs immediate output, budget for the wait.

name: Veo
desc: Google DeepMind 视频模型，原生带音频。
caveat: 生成时长仍有限制，长镜头要分段拼接，衔接处要注意一致性。
descEn: Google DeepMind's video model with native synchronised audio and near-live-action texture.
caveatEn: Output duration is still limited, so long shots must be stitched — watch consistency at the seams.

name: Runway
desc: 老牌 AI 视频平台，工具箱最全。
caveat: 工具箱最全也最贵，中文提示词支持一般，非英语母语者需要额外适应。
descEn: The most complete professional video toolkit, including inpainting and motion brush.
caveatEn: The fullest toolbox is also the priciest, and Chinese prompt support is average — non-native English speakers need extra adaptation.

name: 海螺视频
desc: MiniMax 视频生成，镜头语言丰富。
caveat: 运动幅度大是优点，但细节稳定性略逊于第一梯队，人脸容易出现轻微变形。
descEn: MiniMax's video model with rich camera language and large motion range.
caveatEn: Big motion is the upside, but fine detail is less stable than the top tier — faces can warp slightly.

name: Vidu
desc: 生数科技视频模型，参考一致性不错。
caveat: 国产可用性好，但在复杂物理场景的连贯性上和国际旗舰有差距。
descEn: A Chinese video model with good accessibility and coherent short clips.
caveatEn: Accessible in China, but coherence in complex physical scenes trails the international flagships.

name: Pika
desc: 轻量 AI 视频，特效玩法多。
caveat: 擅长风格化和小特效，写实长镜头不是它的强项。
descEn: Video generation focused on stylised effects and short-form fun.
caveatEn: Excellent at stylised effects, not at realistic long takes.

name: Suno
desc: 一句话生成完整歌曲，含人声编曲。
caveat: 版权归属与商用范围必须看清条款——不同套餐的授权差别很大。
descEn: Full-song generation with convincing vocals and arrangement, covering a wide range of styles.
caveatEn: Copyright ownership and commercial scope must be checked per plan — the terms differ substantially between tiers.

name: ElevenLabs
desc: 顶级语音合成与克隆，多语言配音。
caveat: 价格偏高，且音色克隆功能有明确的授权要求，未授权克隆他人声音涉及侵权。
descEn: The naturalness benchmark for speech synthesis, with convincing multilingual dubbing and fine emotional control.
caveatEn: Expensive, and voice cloning has explicit authorisation requirements. Cloning someone's voice without consent is an infringement.

name: Udio
desc: 音乐生成，编曲细节控制好。
caveat: 音乐性不错但人声自然度略逊，且免费额度受限明显。
descEn: Music generation with strong musicality across genres.
caveatEn: Good musicianship but vocal naturalness lags slightly, and the free tier is clearly limited.

name: Fish Audio
desc: 开源语音合成，中文音色丰富。
caveat: 中文音色不错，但多语言表现不均，做小语种要实测。
descEn: Strong Chinese voice synthesis with a broad tone library and controllable prosody.
caveatEn: Good Chinese voices, but multilingual performance is uneven — test your target languages before committing.

name: MiniMax 语音
desc: 国产语音合成与音乐生成 API。
caveat: 语音质量高但和自家其他能力绑定，单独做 TTS 对比专门厂商优势不明显。
descEn: MiniMax's speech models with high synthesis quality and emotion control.
caveatEn: High quality but bundled with the rest of MiniMax's stack. For pure TTS it's not obviously better than dedicated vendors.

name: Notion AI
desc: 知识库里的 AI 写作、总结与问答。
caveat: 能力绑定在 Notion 里，脱离它的文档体系就没用了。中文语感也一般。
descEn: AI layered into Notion — drafting, summarising and Q&A over your workspace.
caveatEn: Capability is bound to Notion. Outside its document system it's useless, and Chinese language quality is average.

name: Gamma
desc: 一句话生成 PPT / 网页 / 文档。
caveat: 生成的版式好看但常「不好讲」——信息密度不均，按实际投影效果调过再用。
descEn: Presentation generation with a stronger narrative feel than traditional slide tools.
caveatEn: The layouts look good but often present badly — uneven information density. Adjust for your actual projector before using it live.

name: Grammarly
desc: 英文语法与语气润色，写作伴侣。
caveat: 只适用于英文写作，中文内容用不上。
descEn: English grammar, clarity and tone correction that integrates almost everywhere you type.
caveatEn: English only. Useless for Chinese content.

name: 秘塔写作猫
desc: 中文校对、改写与降重。
caveat: 写作场景的垂直优化，通用问答能力不强。
descEn: Metaso's writing-focused assistant for Chinese long-form content.
caveatEn: Vertically optimised for writing. General Q&A is not strong.

name: WPS AI
desc: 国产办公套件 AI，文档表格演示全覆盖。
caveat: 深度绑定 WPS，导出的文档在 Office 里可能有排版差异。
descEn: Kingsoft's AI inside WPS Office, generating documents, sheets and slides in place.
caveatEn: Tied to WPS. Documents exported to Microsoft Office can show layout differences.

name: 腾讯文档 AI
desc: 在线协作文档内置 AI 助手。
caveat: 绑定腾讯文档生态，且协作场景的权限设置需要额外注意。
descEn: AI inside Tencent Docs for drafting and summarising collaborative documents.
caveatEn: Bound to the Tencent Docs ecosystem, and permission settings in shared scenarios need extra care.

name: Perplexity
desc: 答案式 AI 搜索，带引用来源。
caveat: 中文内容的覆盖不如英文，问中文语境的问题时容易出现「用英文资料回答中文问题」的错位。
descEn: Answer-style search that cites its sources for every claim.
caveatEn: Chinese content coverage is thinner than English, so Chinese-context questions often get English-material answers that miss the point.

name: 秘塔 AI 搜索
desc: 国产无广告 AI 搜索，学术模式好用。
caveat: 中文学术检索是强项，但通用问答深度不如综合型助手。
descEn: Chinese AI search with a strong academic and Chinese-web focus.
caveatEn: Academic search is the strength, but general Q&A depth is below a general-purpose assistant.

name: NotebookLM
desc: 上传资料生成播客与知识问答。
caveat: 只回答你上传的资料，问它资料之外的东西会说不知道——这是特性不是缺陷，但要清楚。
descEn: Google's tool for indexing your own documents and answering questions with citations.
caveatEn: Only answers from what you upload and will say it doesn't know otherwise. That's a feature, but you must understand it.

name: Elicit
desc: 文献综述自动化，适合科研。
caveat: 聚焦学术文献提取，做通用调研会显得局限。
descEn: Extracts structured data from academic literature into tables.
caveatEn: Focused on academic paper extraction. Too narrow for general research.

name: Consensus
desc: 从论文里找证据，回答是否/多少。
caveat: 只汇总论文结论，不覆盖行业报告和新闻，做市场调研时不够用。
descEn: Aggregates conclusions from peer-reviewed papers on a question.
caveatEn: Covers papers only — no industry reports or news. Insufficient for market research.

name: 天工 AI
desc: 昆仑万维 AI 搜索与研究助手。
caveat: 国产搜索增强，英文和学术资料的覆盖弱于国际同类。
descEn: A domestic AI search product with good Chinese web coverage.
caveatEn: English and academic coverage trails international equivalents.

name: Manus
desc: 通用型 AI 智能体，能自己规划并执行任务。
caveat: 自主执行能力强也意味着不可控——涉及写操作、发消息这类不可逆动作时务必人工确认。
descEn: An autonomous agent that plans and executes multi-step tasks in a cloud environment.
caveatEn: Autonomy also means unpredictability. For irreversible actions — writing, sending, deleting — insist on human confirmation.

name: 扣子 Coze
desc: 字节的智能体搭建平台，可一键发布到多端。
caveat: 偏对话 Bot 场景，做复杂多步工作流时编排能力弱于专业工作流工具。
descEn: ByteDance's platform for building chat bots with plugins and knowledge bases.
caveatEn: Skewed towards conversational bots. For complex multi-step workflows, orchestration is weaker than dedicated tools.

name: Dify
desc: 开源 LLM 应用开发平台，可视化编排。
caveat: 功能全但配置项多，简单场景用它反而绕。自部署版运维成本要算进去。
descEn: An open-source LLM app platform covering agents, workflows and RAG in one place.
caveatEn: Feature-rich also means configuration-heavy — overkill for simple cases. Self-hosting adds operational cost.

name: n8n
desc: 可自部署的自动化工作流，AI 节点丰富。
caveat: 自部署灵活，但节点众多学习曲线陡，且复杂流程的调试体验一般。
descEn: Open-source workflow automation that can self-host and connect to anything with an API.
caveatEn: Self-hosting is flexible, but the node count makes the learning curve steep and debugging complex flows is tedious.

name: Zapier
desc: 老牌自动化平台，已全面 AI 化。
caveat: 按任务计费，流程跑多了成本上升很快，高频率场景建议自建。
descEn: The most mature no-code automation platform, connecting thousands of SaaS tools.
caveatEn: Priced per task, so costs climb quickly at volume. High-frequency flows are better self-hosted.

name: LangChain
desc: 最流行的 LLM 应用开发框架。
caveat: 抽象层多，出问题时排查链路长。简单场景直接用官方 SDK 往往更清楚。
descEn: The most widely used LLM application framework, with connectors for nearly everything.
caveatEn: Many abstraction layers make problems hard to trace. For simple cases, using the vendor SDK directly is clearer.

name: Flowise
desc: 拖拽式搭建 LLM 流程，开源。
caveat: 可视化拖拽方便但表达力受限，复杂逻辑最终还是要写代码。
descEn: Drag-and-drop LLM app builder with a low barrier to entry.
caveatEn: Visual building is convenient but expressive power is limited. Complex logic still ends up in code.

name: Figma AI
desc: 设计工具内置生成、改写与原型能力。
caveat: AI 能力是插件生态的集合，没有统一的入口和一致的体验。
descEn: AI integrated into Figma through plugins and native features.
caveatEn: AI capability here is a collection of plugins — no single entry point and no consistent experience.

name: Canva AI
desc: 模板 + AI 生成，非设计师也能出图。
caveat: 模板化明显，做品牌视觉容易和别人的作品撞脸。
descEn: AI generation and editing inside Canva, the easiest way to produce everyday design.
caveatEn: Heavily templated. Brand visuals can end up looking like everyone else's.

name: Magnific
desc: 图像超分与细节增强，放大不糊。
caveat: 放大与细节增强效果强，但会「重新创作」细节——产品图这类要求保真的场景要慎用。
descEn: AI upscaling and detail enhancement that adds plausible texture to low-resolution images.
caveatEn: It invents detail rather than recovering it. Avoid it for product photos and anything requiring fidelity.

name: 稿定 AI
desc: 国产设计工具，电商图与抠图能力强。
caveat: 国产模板量大，但定制深度有限，做品牌规范时不够用。
descEn: A Chinese design platform with a large template library and AI generation.
caveatEn: Huge template volume, but limited customisation depth — not enough for brand guidelines work.

name: Julius AI
desc: 上传表格直接对话式分析并出图。
caveat: 自然语言分析上手快，但数据量大时性能和口径控制不如专业工具。
descEn: Upload data and analyse it conversationally, with charts produced along the way.
caveatEn: Natural-language analysis is fast to start, but performance and column-definition control fall short of professional tools.

name: Hex
desc: 团队数据科学平台，内置 AI 助手。
caveat: 协作 Notebook 体验好，但绑定平台，本地环境迁移不顺畅。
descEn: Collaborative notebooks for data science with AI assistance and sharing built in.
caveatEn: Great collaboration experience, but platform-bound — migrating to a local environment is awkward.

name: Meshy
desc: 文生 3D 模型与贴图，游戏可用。
caveat: 生成模型拓扑不规整，直接进引擎前通常需要清理。
descEn: Text-to-3D model generation with consistent styling and interactive preview.
caveatEn: Generated topology is irregular — cleanup is usually needed before it goes into an engine.

name: Tripo AI
desc: 国产文生 3D，速度快、拓扑干净。
caveat: 出模速度快，但细节精度有限，适合占位与概念阶段。
descEn: A Chinese text-to-3D platform supporting multi-view input and automatic rigging.
caveatEn: Fast generation, but detail precision is limited — suited to placeholder and concept work.

name: Rodin
desc: 高质量 3D 资产生成，支持扫描输入。
caveat: 质量不错但按次计费，大批量生成成本不低。
descEn: High-quality text and image to 3D generation, from geometry through to texture.
caveatEn: Good quality but billed per generation, so bulk production gets expensive.

name: Ollama
desc: 一行命令本地跑开源大模型。
caveat: 开箱即用但性能调优空间小，高并发场景请换 vLLM 或 SGLang。
descEn: The easiest way to run open models locally — one command and it's working.
caveatEn: Easy to start but limited tuning headroom. For high concurrency, move to vLLM or SGLang.

name: LM Studio
desc: 图形界面的本地模型运行器，新手友好。
caveat: 桌面端体验好，但不适合做服务端，多用户并发支持弱。
descEn: A desktop app for downloading and running local GGUF models with a clean interface.
caveatEn: Great desktop experience, but not a server. Multi-user concurrency support is weak.

name: Open WebUI
desc: 自托管的类 ChatGPT 界面，兼容多种后端。
caveat: 界面完善但功能堆叠多，资源占用不低，小机器上会吃紧。
descEn: A self-hosted chat interface for local models, with RAG and user management.
caveatEn: Feature-rich but resource-hungry. Small machines will struggle.

name: vLLM
desc: 高吞吐推理引擎，生产部署首选。
caveat: 吞吐最强但配置项多，小规模场景用它是过度工程。
descEn: The standard for deploying open models in production, with PagedAttention for high throughput.
caveatEn: Highest throughput but heavy configuration. Over-engineering for small-scale use.

name: Hugging Face
desc: AI 界的 GitHub，模型与数据集大本营。
caveat: 国内网络不稳定，且模型许可差异极大，商用前逐个确认。
descEn: The hub for open models, datasets and demo apps.
caveatEn: Network access from China is unstable, and model licences vary enormously — check each one before commercial use.

name: llama.cpp
desc: 极致轻量的本地推理，CPU 也能跑。
caveat: CPU 也能跑是优势，但纯 CPU 推理速度只适合轻量场景。
descEn: Runs quantised models efficiently across CPU, GPU and Apple Silicon.
caveatEn: Running on CPU is the advantage, but pure-CPU inference is only fast enough for light use.

name: 腾讯元宝
desc: 腾讯混元大模型助手，深度接入微信生态与腾讯文档。
caveat: 深度依赖腾讯生态，脱离微信和腾讯文档场景后差异化不明显。
descEn: Tencent's Hunyuan-powered assistant, wired into WeChat and Tencent Docs.
caveatEn: Heavily tied to Tencent's ecosystem. Outside WeChat and Tencent Docs scenarios the differentiation is thin.

name: 文心一言
desc: 百度文心大模型，中文理解与检索整合能力强。
caveat: 产品线版本多，需要确认具体型号；开放能力相比头部有差距。
descEn: Baidu's Wenxin models. Strong Chinese knowledge integration with a large enterprise customer base.
caveatEn: Many product versions to wade through, and open capabilities trail the leading labs.

name: 讯飞星火
desc: 科大讯飞大模型，语音交互与教育场景见长。
caveat: 纯文本推理不在第一梯队，它的价值集中在语音识别与合成、以及教育场景。
descEn: iFlytek's model. Industry-leading Chinese speech recognition and synthesis, with deep education-scenario tuning.
caveatEn: Pure text reasoning isn't first tier — its value is concentrated in voice and education.

name: 百小应
desc: 百川智能的 AI 助手，医疗与健康问答有专门优化。
caveat: 定位偏医疗健康垂直，通用任务上没必要专门选它。
descEn: Baichuan's assistant, with specific optimisation for medical and health Q&A.
caveatEn: Positioned as a vertical medical assistant. For general tasks there's no reason to pick it specifically.

name: 跃问
desc: 阶跃星辰多模态助手，图片理解与长文档解析突出。
caveat: 多模态理解是强项，纯文本长文写作并非它的主打方向。
descEn: StepFun's multimodal assistant. Stands out at image understanding and long-document parsing.
caveatEn: Multimodal understanding is the strength; long-form text writing is not its focus.

name: Qwen Chat
desc: 通义千问官方对话站，可直接切换 Qwen 各尺寸模型。
caveat: 这是官方对话站而不是 API 控制台，要接进自己的系统请去阿里云百炼。
descEn: The official Qwen chat site, where you can switch between Qwen models of various sizes.
caveatEn: This is a chat site, not an API console. To integrate into your own system, go to Alibaba Cloud Bailian instead.

name: 商量 SenseChat
desc: 商汤日日新大模型，多模态与代码能力均衡。
caveat: 能力均衡但没有明显长板，同价位通常有更专精的选择。
descEn: SenseTime's SenseChat. Balanced across multimodal and code, without an obvious weak spot.
caveatEn: Balanced also means no standout strength. At the same price you can usually find something more specialised.

name: 360 智脑
desc: 360 的 AI 助手，接入自家搜索做实时增强。
caveat: 搜索增强依赖自家检索质量，冷门问题的答案可靠性一般。
descEn: 360's assistant, augmenting answers with its own search index.
caveatEn: Search augmentation depends on the quality of its own retrieval, so answers on niche topics are unreliable.

name: Poe
desc: Quora 出的模型聚合平台，一个订阅用遍各家模型和自建 Bot。
caveat: 聚合层意味着你无法控制底层模型的版本和配额变化，做生产系统别依赖它。
descEn: Quora's model aggregator — one subscription for many providers' models plus custom bots.
caveatEn: As an aggregator you don't control the underlying model versions or quotas. Don't build a production system on it.

name: Character.AI
desc: 角色扮演对话平台，可自制人设 Bot。
caveat: 角色扮演向，事实类问答的准确性不能当通用助手用。
descEn: Roleplay-focused chat where you can create your own persona bots.
caveatEn: Built for roleplay. Its factual accuracy isn't good enough to use as a general assistant.

name: Meta AI
desc: Meta Llama 系列官方助手，已接入 WhatsApp / Instagram。
caveat: 区域可用性限制多，且被整合进社交产品里，独立使用体验一般。
descEn: Meta's Llama-powered assistant, integrated into WhatsApp and Instagram.
caveatEn: Regional availability is patchy, and being bundled into social apps makes for a mediocre standalone experience.

name: HuggingChat
desc: Hugging Face 的免费对话入口，底层模型可自由切换。
caveat: 免费额度对应的是小尺寸开源模型，别拿它的表现评价整个模型家族。
descEn: Hugging Face's free chat entry point, with freely switchable underlying models.
caveatEn: The free tier runs small open models. Don't judge a whole model family by how HuggingChat performs.

name: OpenRouter
desc: 一个 API Key 调用几百个模型，价格与可用性统一比较，开发者必备。
caveat: 它只是转发，上游限流或故障会直接传到你这。生产环境建议同时配置直连备用通道。
descEn: One API key for several hundred models, with pricing and availability in a single place. Essential for developers comparing providers.
caveatEn: It only forwards requests — upstream rate limits and outages land on you. For production, configure a direct fallback channel alongside it.

name: Cline
desc: VS Code 里的开源编程 Agent，自带浏览器操作与终端执行。
caveat: 免费指的是插件本身，模型调用仍然要你自己付费，重度使用成本会明显上升。
descEn: An open-source coding agent for VS Code, with browser control and terminal execution built in.
caveatEn: 'Free' refers to the extension — you still pay for model calls, and heavy use gets expensive fast.

name: Roomote
desc: 原 Roo Code 团队转型的云端编程 Agent，从 Slack 派活，交回来的是 PR。
caveat: VS Code 扩展已于 2026 年 5 月归档停更，想在编辑器里继续用可以转社区分支 ZooCode 或回到 Cline。
descEn: Cloud coding agent from the team behind Roo Code. Dispatch it from Slack, get a reviewable PR back.
caveatEn: The VS Code extension was archived in May 2026 and no longer maintained. To stay in the editor, move to the community fork ZooCode, or back to Cline.

name: Aider
desc: 命令行 AI 结对编程，改动自动提交 git，可回溯。
caveat: 命令行 + git 驱动，不熟 git 的人容易把自己绕进去。它默认自动提交，要留意提交历史。
descEn: Command-line AI pair programming that auto-commits each change to git, so everything is reversible.
caveatEn: Git-driven from the command line — people who aren't comfortable with git can get tangled. It commits automatically, so watch your history.

name: Continue
desc: 开源 IDE 助手，模型可自选本地或云端，配置透明。
caveat: 定位是助手而非 Agent，跨文件的大改动不是它的场景。
descEn: An open-source IDE assistant with freely selectable local or cloud models and transparent configuration.
caveatEn: It's an assistant, not an agent. Large cross-file changes aren't its scenario.

name: Sourcegraph Cody
desc: 擅长在超大型代码库里定位与理解上下文。
caveat: 优势只在超大代码库，中小项目用它的性价比不如通用 AI IDE。
descEn: Sourcegraph's assistant, exceptional at locating and understanding context in very large codebases.
caveatEn: Its advantage only shows in huge repositories. For small and mid-sized projects, a general AI IDE is better value.

name: Tabnine
desc: 老牌代码补全，主打企业私有部署与代码不外流。
caveat: 主打私有部署和代码不外流，纯能力上落后于同价位竞品。
descEn: A long-standing code completion tool built around enterprise self-hosting and keeping code in-house.
caveatEn: Its focus is private deployment and keeping code off third-party servers. On raw capability it trails same-priced competitors.

name: Amazon Q Developer
desc: AWS 官方编程助手，云资源与 IaC 场景一体化。
caveat: 深度绑定 AWS，不用 AWS 的话它的很多能力用不上。
descEn: AWS's developer assistant, integrated with cloud resources and infrastructure-as-code.
caveatEn: Deeply tied to AWS. If you don't use AWS, much of its capability is unreachable.

name: JetBrains AI
desc: IntelliJ 全家桶内置 AI，深度融入重构与导航。
caveat: 只在 JetBrains 家族里好用，跨语言跨生态的支持不如独立产品。
descEn: AI built into the IntelliJ family, closely woven into refactoring and navigation.
caveatEn: Only good inside the JetBrains family. Cross-language and cross-ecosystem support is weaker than standalone products.

name: Zed
desc: Rust 写的高性能编辑器，自带协作与 AI 面板。
caveat: 编辑器很新，插件生态远不及 VS Code，重度依赖特定插件的团队慎选。
descEn: A high-performance Rust-based editor with built-in collaboration and an AI panel.
caveatEn: A very new editor — the plugin ecosystem is nowhere near VS Code. Teams depending on specific extensions should think twice.

name: Devin
desc: Cognition 的自主软件工程师，能独立完成中等规模的工单。
caveat: 按任务计费，复杂工单的成本不可预测。适合有明确验收标准的中等工单，不适合探索性需求。
descEn: Cognition's autonomous software engineer, able to complete mid-sized tickets on its own.
caveatEn: Billed per task, so costs on complex tickets are unpredictable. Suits well-specified mid-sized work, not exploratory requests.

name: Lovable
desc: 对话式生成全栈应用，产出可维护的代码而非黑盒。
caveat: 生成的是完整应用，但一旦需求偏离常规 CRUD，改造难度会陡增。
descEn: Builds full-stack apps through conversation and produces maintainable code rather than a black box.
caveatEn: It generates a complete application, but once requirements stray from conventional CRUD, reworking it gets steep fast.

name: Firebase Studio
desc: Google 的云端全栈 AI 工作台，从提示到部署一条龙。
caveat: 绑定 Google Cloud 生态，且云端 IDE 对大型本地项目支持有限。
descEn: Google's cloud full-stack AI workspace, from prompt to deployment.
caveatEn: Locked to Google Cloud, and a cloud IDE has limited support for large local projects.

name: Augment Code
desc: 面向大型工程的上下文引擎，强调真实仓库理解。
caveat: 企业向定价，个人或小团队成本偏高。
descEn: A context engine aimed at large engineering organisations, focused on real repository understanding.
caveatEn: Enterprise pricing puts it out of reach for individuals and small teams.

name: 通义灵码
desc: 阿里云免费 AI 编码助手，中文注释与文档友好。
caveat: 免费额度友好，但深度定制能力弱于付费竞品。
descEn: Alibaba Cloud's free AI coding assistant. Good with Chinese comments and documentation.
caveatEn: Generous free tier, but deep customisation is weaker than paid competitors.

name: 文心快码
desc: 百度 AI 编码助手，支持多语言与代码库问答。
caveat: 国产链路完整，但插件市场覆盖和更新速度落后于国际产品。
descEn: Baidu's AI coding assistant with multi-language support and codebase Q&A.
caveatEn: A complete domestic chain, but plugin-market coverage and update cadence trail international products.

name: CodeGeeX
desc: 智谱开源代码模型与插件，可本地部署。
caveat: 开源模型适合本地化，但生成质量与商业旗舰有可感差距。
descEn: Zhipu's open-source code model and plugin — deployable entirely on your own hardware.
caveatEn: Open models are good for localisation, but generation quality is perceptibly behind commercial flagships.

name: Stable Diffusion
desc: 开源文生图奠基之作，权重可下载本地跑，生态最大。
caveat: 名字指的是模型家族而非某个产品，直接用官方站体验远不如 ComfyUI 生态。
descEn: The open-source foundation of text-to-image. The largest ecosystem by far, with weights you can run locally.
caveatEn: This is a model family, not a product. The official site gives a far worse experience than the ComfyUI ecosystem around it.

name: Adobe Firefly
desc: Adobe 官方生成模型，训练数据版权清晰，可商用放心。
caveat: 版权干净是最大卖点，代价是风格保守、生成速度偏慢。
descEn: Adobe's own generation models, trained on clearly licensed data — safe for commercial use.
caveatEn: Clean licensing is the main draw. The cost is conservative styling and slower generation.

name: Leonardo.Ai
desc: 游戏与概念美术方向，风格模型和资产管理做得好。
caveat: 偏游戏概念美术，做通用商业设计时风格会显得太「游戏」。
descEn: Aimed at game and concept art, with strong style models and asset management.
caveatEn: Skewed towards game concept art. For general commercial design, the style reads as too 'gamey'.

name: Civitai
desc: 最大的开源绘图模型社区，LoRA 与 Checkpoint 大本营。
caveat: 是模型社区不是出图平台，需要配合本地或云端运行环境才能真正用起来。
descEn: The largest community for open image models — the home of LoRAs and checkpoints.
caveatEn: It's a model community, not a generation platform. You need your own local or cloud runtime to actually use anything.

name: LiblibAI
desc: 国内最大的 AI 绘画模型社区与在线出图平台。
caveat: 在线出图方便但排队和额度受限，大批量生产还是本地更划算。
descEn: China's largest AI art community and online generation platform.
caveatEn: Online generation is convenient, but queues and quotas bite. For bulk production, local is still more economical.

name: 通义万相
desc: 阿里的图像与视频生成，中文提示词理解到位。
caveat: 中文提示理解好，但风格库和社区生态不如专业绘画平台丰富。
descEn: Alibaba's image and video generation, with solid Chinese prompt understanding.
caveatEn: Good Chinese comprehension, but the style library and community ecosystem are thinner than dedicated art platforms.

name: 文心一格
desc: 百度 AI 绘画，中国风与国潮素材库丰富。
caveat: 中国风素材丰富，风格多样性上明显偏窄。
descEn: Baidu's AI art tool, with a rich library of Chinese-style and guochao material.
caveatEn: Strong on Chinese-style material, noticeably narrow in style diversity.

name: 无界 AI
desc: 国产绘画平台，模特换装与电商场景有专门模型。
caveat: 电商场景专门优化，其他方向的通用性一般。
descEn: A Chinese generation platform with dedicated models for model-swap and e-commerce scenarios.
caveatEn: Optimised for e-commerce. Generality in other directions is average.

name: Microsoft Designer
desc: 微软的图像生成入口，原名 Bing 图像创建器。DALL·E 驱动，免费额度大方。
caveat: 免费额度大方但排队慢、内容过滤偏严，商业素材容易触发限制。入口已从 bing.com/images/create 迁到 Designer（旧地址 2026-09 实测 404），生成能力并入 Copilot；新地址 2026-09 直连实测可打开。
descEn: Microsoft's image generation entry point, formerly Bing Image Creator. Powered by DALL·E with a generous free quota.
caveatEn: Generous but slow queues, and content filtering is strict — commercial material often trips the limits. The entry moved from bing.com/images/create to Designer (the old address 404s as of our Sept 2026 check) and generation now sits inside Copilot; the new address did respond on a direct check in Sept 2026.

name: remove.bg
desc: 一键抠图去背景，边缘处理干净，有 API 可批量。
caveat: 只做抠图，精细化（比如发丝、半透明物体）需要人工修补，且批量要付费。
descEn: One-click background removal with clean edge handling and a batch API.
caveatEn: Does one thing only. Fine detail — hair, semi-transparent objects — needs manual cleanup, and batch use is paid.

name: Upscayl
desc: 开源本地图像放大，免费无限制，离线可用。
caveat: 本地免费但吃显卡，放大倍数高时可能出现「塑料感」。
descEn: Open-source local image upscaling. Free, unlimited, works offline.
caveatEn: Free and local, but GPU-hungry, and high upscale factors can produce a plasticky look.

name: PhotoRoom
desc: 电商商品图专用：抠图、换背景、加场景一步到位。
caveat: 电商商品图专用，改动主体有虚假宣传风险——只换背景不要改商品本身。
descEn: Purpose-built for e-commerce product shots: cutout, background swap and scene placement in one pass.
caveatEn: E-commerce specific. Altering the product itself risks misrepresentation — change the background only, never the item.

name: Luma Dream Machine
desc: Luma 视频生成，镜头运动自然，支持关键帧控制。
caveat: 镜头运动自然，但部分场景人物一致性一般，连续多镜头要额外做角色锚定。
descEn: Luma's video model with natural camera movement and keyframe control.
caveatEn: Camera movement is natural, but character consistency is inconsistent in some scenes — multiple shots need explicit character anchoring.

name: 腾讯混元视频
desc: 腾讯开源视频生成模型，国产算力上速度快。
caveat: 开源版质量靠前，但自部署算力门槛很高，个人显卡基本跑不动。
descEn: Tencent's open-source video model. Among the best open weights, and fast on domestic compute.
caveatEn: Leading open quality, but self-hosting has a high compute bar — consumer GPUs won't manage it.

name: PixVerse
desc: 爱诗科技视频生成，特效模板多，社交传播友好。
caveat: 模板化痕迹明显，做品牌内容时原创度不足，容易被识别为「AI 味」。
descEn: Aiseesoft's video model with a large library of effect templates, built for social sharing.
caveatEn: Templates leave obvious fingerprints. For brand content the originality is too low and it reads as 'AI-generated'.

name: HeyGen
desc: 数字人口播视频，一次录音后可用任意语言输出。
caveat: 数字人口型效果好但「一眼AI」，严肃品牌场景慎用。价格按分钟计，长视频成本高。
descEn: Digital human talking-head video. Record once, output in any language.
caveatEn: Lip-sync is solid but it still looks obviously AI, so use it carefully for serious brand work. Priced per minute, which adds up for long videos.

name: Synthesia
desc: 企业级数字人视频，培训与内部沟通场景成熟。
caveat: 企业级定位，价格不在个人可承受范围，且模板感较强。
descEn: Enterprise digital human video, mature for training and internal communications.
caveatEn: Enterprise positioning means pricing outside individual budgets, and the output feels templated.

name: D-ID
desc: 让静态照片开口说话，老照片动起来这类效果。
caveat: 让照片说话的效果偏「恐怖谷」，正式内容里容易显得诡异。
descEn: Makes still photos speak — useful for bringing old photographs to life.
caveatEn: Talking-photo output sits deep in the uncanny valley. In formal content it can come across as unsettling rather than impressive.

name: 剪映
desc: 国内最普及的剪辑工具，AI 成片、字幕、数字人一应俱全。
caveat: 免费版功能已受限，部分素材商用需要额外授权，做商业项目前确认清楚。
descEn: The most widely used Chinese editing tool, with AI auto-edit, subtitles and digital humans all built in.
caveatEn: The free tier is already limited, and some assets need extra licensing for commercial use. Check before using it on paid work.

name: Descript
desc: 像改文档一样剪视频，删掉某句话对应的画面就跟着没了。
caveat: 中文支持不如英文，且它的核心是「改文档式剪辑」，复杂特效它做不了。
descEn: Edit video like a document — delete a sentence and the matching footage goes with it.
caveatEn: Chinese support is weaker than English, and its core is document-style editing. Complex effects are out of scope.

name: OpusClip
desc: 长视频自动切成高光短视频，直接适配竖屏平台。
caveat: 自动切片经常前半句没头没尾，人工过一遍开头结尾是必要的。
descEn: Automatically cuts long videos into highlight shorts formatted for vertical platforms.
caveatEn: Auto-cut clips frequently start or end mid-sentence. Reviewing the first and last few seconds by hand is not optional.

name: Hedra
desc: 角色表演驱动，上传照片配音频即可生成说话动画。
caveat: 角色表演驱动效果依赖源图质量，且生成时长有限制。
descEn: Character performance driving — upload a photo and an audio track to generate a talking animation.
caveatEn: Results depend heavily on the quality of the source image, and generation length is capped.

name: Adobe Podcast
desc: 一键把手机录的嘈杂人声修成录音棚效果，免费额度够用。
caveat: 只解决降噪与音质，剪辑和转写要另找工具。免费额度也有限。
descEn: Turns a phone recording into a studio-sounding voice track. Free tier is enough for casual use.
caveatEn: Solves denoising and tone only. Editing and transcription need separate tools, and the free quota is limited.

name: Murf AI
desc: 商用配音为主，音色多、支持逐句微调语气。
caveat: 商用配音为主，价格按字符计，长篇内容成本不低。
descEn: Commercial voiceover-first platform with many voice options and per-sentence delivery control.
caveatEn: Priced per character, so long-form content gets costly quickly.

name: PlayHT
desc: 低延迟语音合成，适合做实时语音对话应用。
caveat: 低延迟是优势，但音色库的丰富度不如头部 TTS 厂商。
descEn: Low-latency speech synthesis suited to real-time voice conversation applications.
caveatEn: Low latency is the advantage, but the voice library is less rich than the leading TTS vendors.

name: Whisper
desc: OpenAI 开源的语音识别模型，本地跑、多语言、可微调。
caveat: 只做识别不做说话人分离，多人会议场景要配合其他工具（如 pyannote）。
descEn: OpenAI's open-source speech recognition model. Runs locally, multilingual, fine-tunable.
caveatEn: Does recognition only, no speaker separation. Multi-person meetings need a companion tool like pyannote.

name: Stable Audio
desc: 生成音效与配乐片段，适合做视频背景音。
caveat: 生成的是短片段音效，做完整配乐要多次拼接，过渡容易生硬。
descEn: Generates sound effects and short music beds, good for video background audio.
caveatEn: It generates short clips, so full soundtracks require stitching — transitions tend to sound abrupt.

name: Google Flow Music
desc: 原 Riffusion，被 Google 收购后重做。像聊天一样反复改歌，能拆轨。
caveat: 前身 Riffusion 已并入 Google Flow 系列，独立版本不再存在。输出嵌 SynthID 水印，商用前先看平台条款。
descEn: Formerly Riffusion, rebuilt by Google after the acquisition. Iterate on a track by chatting, with stem splitting.
caveatEn: Riffusion as a standalone product no longer exists — it became ProducerAI, then part of Google Flow. Output is SynthID-watermarked; read the platform terms before commercial use.

name: 海绵音乐
desc: 字节的音乐生成，中文歌词与和声处理贴合华语审美。
caveat: 中文歌词贴合度好，但编曲复杂度有限，成品听起来偏「模板歌」。
descEn: ByteDance's music generation, with Chinese lyrics and harmony tuned to local taste.
caveatEn: Chinese lyrics fit well, but arrangement complexity is limited — the output can sound like a template song.

name: Krisp
desc: 实时通话降噪与回声消除，开会时屏蔽键盘声和背景人声。
caveat: 实时降噪在极端噪声下会吃掉人声细节，重要会议建议同时本地录音备份。
descEn: Real-time call denoising and echo cancellation — filters keyboard noise and background voices in meetings.
caveatEn: Aggressive denoising can eat detail from the human voice. For important meetings, also record locally as a backup.

name: CosyVoice
desc: 阿里开源的语音合成，3 秒音频即可克隆音色。
caveat: 自部署需要一定工程能力，且音色克隆务必获得本人授权。
descEn: Alibaba's open-source speech synthesis — clone a voice from three seconds of audio.
caveatEn: Self-hosting takes some engineering effort, and voice cloning absolutely requires the speaker's consent.

name: GPT-SoVITS
desc: 社区最火的开源音色克隆方案，几分钟数据就能训出可用音色。
caveat: 社区项目，版本迭代快、配置容易踩坑，且同样有音色授权问题。
descEn: The most popular open-source voice cloning approach in the community — a usable voice from a few minutes of data.
caveatEn: A community project with fast-moving versions and fiddly configuration. The same voice-consent rules apply.

name: 飞书智能伙伴
desc: 嵌入飞书文档、表格、会议的 AI，企业知识库问答是强项。
caveat: 绑定飞书，脱离企业套件后价值有限。知识库问答效果强依赖内部资料整理质量。
descEn: AI embedded across Feishu documents, sheets and meetings — enterprise knowledge Q&A is the strong point.
caveatEn: Tied to Feishu. Outside the suite its value drops, and knowledge-base answers depend heavily on how well your internal material is organised.

name: DeepL
desc: 翻译质量标杆，长句和专业术语处理比通用模型稳。
caveat: 翻译质量高但免费额度有限，且它不做改写和润色，只做翻译。
descEn: The translation quality benchmark, handling long sentences and terminology more reliably than general models.
caveatEn: High quality but the free tier is limited, and it only translates — no rewriting or polishing.

name: 沉浸式翻译
desc: 浏览器双语对照翻译插件，可接自己的 API Key，看外文资料神器。
caveat: 插件形态，手机端和 PDF 的支持不如网页正文稳定。要接自己的 API Key 才划算。
descEn: Bilingual browser translation extension. Bring your own API key and read foreign material with two columns side by side.
caveatEn: It's an extension, so mobile and PDF support is less stable than web body text. You need your own API key for it to be economical.

name: QuillBot
desc: 英文改写与降重，同义替换比通用模型更自然。
caveat: 主打英文降重，中文内容完全用不上。
descEn: English paraphrasing and rewriting with more natural synonym choice than general models.
caveatEn: Built for English rewriting. Completely unusable for Chinese content.

name: Jasper
desc: 面向品牌营销的文案平台，强调品牌语调一致性。
caveat: 价格在同类里偏高，且它的优势主要在品牌语调一致性，个人创作者性价比一般。
descEn: Brand marketing copy platform emphasising consistent brand voice across materials.
caveatEn: Priced high for its class, and its advantage is mainly brand-voice consistency — poor value for individual creators.

name: Copy.ai
desc: 营销文案与销售外联自动化，自带工作流编排。
caveat: 营销文案模板化明显，产出常需要大改才能用。
descEn: Marketing copy and sales outreach automation with built-in workflow orchestration.
caveatEn: Output is noticeably templated and usually needs substantial editing before use.

name: Tome
desc: 叙事型演示文稿生成，强调故事线而非版式（2025-04 已停运）。
caveat: 叙事化演示有特色，但严谨的商务汇报反而需要更朴素的版式。产品已于 2025-04-30 正式停运（官方公告「Goodbye, Tome」），未导出的演示文稿一并删除；团队转型做企业销售/CRM 产品 Lightfield，Tome 品牌于 2025-08 被 AngelList 收购。需要做演示文稿请改用 Gamma 或 Beautiful.ai。
descEn: Narrative-style presentation generation, emphasising storyline over slide layout (shut down April 2025).
caveatEn: Its narrative style is distinctive, but rigorous business reporting often needs a plainer layout. The product was formally shut down on 30 April 2025 (official "Goodbye, Tome" announcement) and decks that were never exported went with it; the team moved on to an enterprise sales/CRM product called Lightfield, and the Tome brand was acquired by AngelList in Aug 2025. Use Gamma or Beautiful.ai for decks instead.

name: Napkin AI
desc: 把文字段落自动转成示意图，写文档/博客配图很省事。
caveat: 文字转示意图效果好，但不适合需要精确数据图表（坐标轴、比例）的场景。
descEn: Turns written paragraphs into diagrams automatically — a real time-saver for document and blog illustrations.
caveatEn: Good at conceptual diagrams, unsuitable for charts that need precise data — axes, proportions, exact values.

name: 讯飞智文
desc: 国产 AI 文档与 PPT 生成，中文排版模板贴合国内场景。
caveat: 模板贴合国内场景，但生成的 PPT 需要按实际投影效果重新调字号。
descEn: iFlytek's AI document and slide generation, with Chinese templates tuned to local conventions.
caveatEn: Templates fit Chinese scenarios, but generated slides need font-size adjustment for actual projection.

name: 有道 AI 翻译
desc: 国产翻译老牌，文档翻译与术语库管理成熟。
caveat: 文档翻译与术语库成熟，但纯翻译质量上 DeepL 在多数语对上更好。
descEn: Youdao's long-standing translation service, with mature document translation and terminology management.
caveatEn: Strong on documents and glossaries, but raw translation quality is better with DeepL for most language pairs.

name: Semantic Scholar
desc: AI 驱动的学术搜索，自动提炼论文要点与引用关系。
caveat: 偏计算机与生物医学领域，人文社科的文献覆盖明显更薄。
descEn: AI-driven academic search that extracts key points and citation relationships automatically.
caveatEn: Skewed towards computer science and biomedicine. Humanities and social sciences are noticeably thinner.

name: Connected Papers
desc: 把一篇论文的引用网络画成图，找相关工作一目了然。
caveat: 免费额度限次数，且它只画引用关系，不判断论文质量。
descEn: Draws a paper's citation network as a graph, making related work obvious at a glance.
caveatEn: Free usage is capped, and it only maps citation relationships — it doesn't judge quality.

name: SciSpace
desc: 上传 PDF 直接对话，公式和表格也能追问。
caveat: 论文问答不错，但公式和复杂表格的解析仍会出错，关键结论要回原文核对。
descEn: Upload a PDF and converse with it, including follow-up questions on formulas and tables.
caveatEn: Paper Q&A is good, but parsing of formulas and complex tables still breaks. Cross-check key conclusions against the original.

name: Scite
desc: 不只是引用次数，而是判断这篇论文是被支持还是被反驳。
caveat: 引用分类判断有价值但订阅价高，个人研究者性价比一般。
descEn: Goes beyond citation counts to show whether a paper has been supported or refuted.
caveatEn: Citation classification is valuable but the subscription is expensive — poor value for individual researchers.

name: STORM
desc: 斯坦福的写作式研究系统，先提问再检索再成稿。
caveat: 生成的是「带引用的长文草稿」，需要人工核对每一条引用是否真的支持该论断。
descEn: Stanford's writing-oriented research system: ask questions, retrieve, then draft.
caveatEn: It generates a cited long-form draft. Every citation must be checked to confirm it actually supports the claim.

name: GPT Researcher
desc: 开源深度研究 Agent，自动多轮检索并生成带引用的报告。
caveat: 开源可自定义，但默认配置的检索质量一般，要做生产系统需要调检索源和提示词。
descEn: Open-source deep research agent that runs multiple retrieval rounds and produces a cited report.
caveatEn: Open and customisable, but default retrieval quality is average. Production use needs tuning of sources and prompts.

name: Exa
desc: 为 AI 设计的搜索引擎 API，支持语义检索与内容抓取。
caveat: 为 AI 设计的搜索 API，返回的是链接和摘要而非直接答案，要自己做后处理。
descEn: A search API designed for AI, supporting semantic retrieval and content extraction.
caveatEn: Returns links and snippets rather than direct answers — you handle the post-processing.

name: Tavily
desc: 给 Agent 用的联网搜索 API，返回结果已做清洗和摘要。
caveat: 返回结果已做清洗，但覆盖广度不如通用搜索引擎，冷门内容容易搜不到。
descEn: A web search API for agents that returns cleaned, summarised results.
caveatEn: Results are cleaned but coverage is narrower than a general search engine. Niche topics may simply not appear.

name: LangGraph
desc: 把 Agent 当状态机来编排，复杂多步流程可控可调试。
caveat: 状态机模型强大但概念多，简单 Agent 用它是杀鸡用牛刀。
descEn: Orchestrates agents as state machines, making complex multi-step flows controllable and debuggable.
caveatEn: Powerful but concept-heavy. For a simple agent it's overkill.

name: CrewAI
desc: 多智能体协作框架，用角色分工的方式拆解复杂任务。
caveat: 多智能体协作效果强依赖角色分工设计，分工不合理时它们会互相干扰。
descEn: Multi-agent collaboration framework that decomposes work by role.
caveatEn: Results depend heavily on how roles are divided. Bad role design makes agents interfere with each other.

name: AutoGen
desc: 微软的多 Agent 对话框架，研究社区使用广。
caveat: 研究社区用得多，生产实践案例相对少，文档和版本变动较快。
descEn: Microsoft's multi-agent conversation framework, widely used in research.
caveatEn: Popular in research but fewer production case studies, and documentation changes quickly between versions.

name: OpenAI Agents SDK
desc: OpenAI 官方 Agent 开发套件，轻量、概念少、上手快。
caveat: 概念少上手快，但深度定制能力不如 LangGraph，复杂控制流会受限。
descEn: OpenAI's official agent SDK — lightweight, few concepts, quick to start.
caveatEn: Few concepts means fast starts but less room for deep customisation. Complex control flow hits its ceiling.

name: LlamaIndex
desc: 数据接入与 RAG 最成熟的框架，各种数据源都有连接器。
caveat: 数据接入最全，但抽象层次高，调优时经常需要绕过它的默认实现。
descEn: The most mature framework for data ingestion and RAG, with connectors for every source.
caveatEn: The most complete data connectors, but the abstraction is high — tuning often means working around its defaults.

name: Vercel AI SDK
desc: 前端友好的 AI 应用 SDK，流式输出与工具调用开箱即用。
caveat: 前端体验最好，但后端复杂的编排逻辑不是它的场景。
descEn: A frontend-friendly AI SDK where streaming and tool calling work out of the box.
caveatEn: The best frontend experience, but complex backend orchestration isn't its scenario.

name: Browser Use
desc: 让 AI 直接操作浏览器，自动化填表、抓数据、跑流程。
caveat: 浏览器自动化稳定性受页面改版影响大，生产环境要加监控和失败重试。
descEn: Lets AI drive a real browser — form filling, scraping, running flows end to end.
caveatEn: Browser automation is fragile against page redesigns. Production use needs monitoring and retry logic.

name: OpenHands
desc: 开源的自主软件工程 Agent，能读写代码、跑命令、调浏览器。
caveat: 能力强的同时也意味着成本不可预测，跑长任务前设好步数上限。
descEn: An open-source autonomous software engineering agent that reads and writes code, runs commands and browses.
caveatEn: Capable also means unpredictably expensive. Set a step limit before running long tasks.

name: RAGFlow
desc: 国产开源 RAG 引擎，文档解析（含表格公式）做得扎实。
caveat: 文档解析扎实但资源占用较高，自部署要留足内存。
descEn: A Chinese open-source RAG engine with notably solid document parsing, including tables and formulas.
caveatEn: Parsing is solid but resource usage is high. Leave plenty of memory if you self-host.

name: FastGPT
desc: 国产开源知识库问答系统，可视化编排、开箱可用。
caveat: 国产开源易上手，但生态插件数量少于头部框架。
descEn: A Chinese open-source knowledge-base Q&A system with visual orchestration, ready out of the box.
caveatEn: Easy to start with, but the plugin ecosystem is smaller than the leading frameworks.

name: Composio
desc: 给 Agent 一键接上几百个 SaaS 工具的身份与调用管理。
caveat: 工具集成的便利性以「把凭证托管给第三方」为代价，安全要求高的场景要评估。
descEn: Connects agents to hundreds of SaaS tools with managed authentication and invocation.
caveatEn: Convenience comes at the cost of handing credentials to a third party. Assess carefully if your security requirements are strict.

name: Mastra
desc: TypeScript 的 Agent 框架，工作流、记忆、评测一体。
caveat: 较新的框架，文档和社区案例还在积累中。
descEn: A TypeScript agent framework integrating workflows, memory and evaluation.
caveatEn: A newer framework — documentation and community examples are still accumulating.

name: Uizard
desc: 草图或截图转成可编辑原型，快速验证想法。
caveat: 草图转原型适合验证想法，产出的东西不能直接当设计稿交付。
descEn: Turns sketches or screenshots into editable prototypes for quick validation.
caveatEn: Good for validating an idea, but the output isn't deliverable as a design file.

name: Framer
desc: 设计即上线，做营销页和作品集的首选，动效能力强。
caveat: 设计即上线的模式很方便，但绑定它的托管服务，迁移成本高。
descEn: Design and publish in one place — the go-to for marketing pages and portfolios, with strong motion.
caveatEn: Design-to-publish is convenient, but it binds you to their hosting. Migration is costly.

name: Looka
desc: AI 生成 Logo 与整套品牌视觉，导出含各类物料。
caveat: 生成的 Logo 适合初创快速起步，但独特性有限，做品牌时容易显得「模板感」。
descEn: AI-generated logos and brand kits with exportable assets for every use.
caveatEn: Fine for a startup getting off the ground, but the output isn't distinctive — brands tend to look templated.

name: Huemint
desc: AI 配色方案生成，直接给到可用的品牌配色组合。
caveat: 只生成配色方案，不解决可用性和对比度问题，拿到后要自己验证可读性。
descEn: AI colour palette generation that returns usable brand colour combinations.
caveatEn: Generates palettes only. It doesn't solve accessibility or contrast — verify readability yourself.

name: Visily
desc: 非设计师也能出高保真原型，模板和 AI 补全都友好。
caveat: 低门槛的代价是可定制性弱，复杂交互原型做不了。
descEn: High-fidelity prototyping for non-designers, with friendly templates and AI completion.
caveatEn: The low barrier means low customisability. Complex interactive prototypes are out of reach.

name: Motiff 妙多
desc: 国产 AI 设计工具，界面设计与 Figma 高度兼容。
caveat: 与 Figma 兼容是卖点，但生态和社区资源仍在建设期。
descEn: A Chinese AI design tool with high compatibility with Figma files.
caveatEn: Figma compatibility is the selling point, but the ecosystem and community resources are still being built.

name: 即时设计
desc: 国产在线设计协作平台，内置 AI 生成与素材库。
caveat: 国产协作平台，插件生态和 Figma 差距明显。
descEn: A Chinese online design collaboration platform with AI generation and built-in assets.
caveatEn: A domestic collaboration platform, but the plugin ecosystem is far behind Figma.

name: Khroma
desc: 先学你喜欢的颜色，再生成无限配色组合。
caveat: 只用你喜欢的颜色做组合，不保证配色的可访问性（对比度）。
descEn: Learns the colours you like, then generates unlimited palettes from them.
caveatEn: Combines colours you like without checking accessibility. Contrast is on you.

name: Rows
desc: 在线表格内嵌 AI 与 API 数据源，做轻量看板很顺手。
caveat: 在线表格内置 AI，但复杂数据量下性能受限。
descEn: An online spreadsheet with AI and API data sources embedded — handy for light dashboards.
caveatEn: AI inside a spreadsheet, but performance suffers at high data volumes.

name: Quadratic
desc: 支持 Python/SQL 的现代电子表格，处理大数据不卡。
caveat: 支持 Python/SQL 是优势，但学习成本高于普通表格。
descEn: A modern spreadsheet with Python and SQL support that handles large data without stalling.
caveatEn: Python and SQL support is the advantage, but the learning cost is higher than a plain spreadsheet.

name: Deepnote
desc: 协作式 Notebook，内置 AI 助手写代码和解释结果。
caveat: 协作场景强，个人做重度计算时不如本地环境灵活。
descEn: A collaborative notebook with an AI assistant that writes code and explains results.
caveatEn: Strong for collaboration, but less flexible than a local environment for heavy computation.

name: Akkio
desc: 面向业务人员的预测建模，上传表格就能跑预测。
caveat: 面向业务人员的预测建模，黑盒程度高，模型可解释性弱。
descEn: Predictive modelling for business users — upload a table and run forecasts.
caveatEn: Built for business users, which means a high degree of black-box behaviour and weak model explainability.

name: Wren AI
desc: 开源 Text-to-SQL 方案，自然语言直接问数据库。
caveat: Text-to-SQL 准确率依赖表结构描述质量，脏库效果会明显下降。
descEn: Open-source text-to-SQL that lets you ask a database questions in plain language.
caveatEn: Accuracy depends on how well your schema is described. On a messy database results drop off noticeably.

name: Vanna
desc: 用 RAG 提升 SQL 生成准确率的开源框架，可训练自己的库。
caveat: 需要自己训练才能达到可用准确率，开箱效果一般。
descEn: An open-source framework that uses RAG to improve SQL generation accuracy.
caveatEn: Requires training before it reaches usable accuracy — out-of-the-box results are average.

name: Power BI Copilot
desc: 微软 BI 内置 AI，用自然语言生成报表和 DAX。
caveat: 需要相应订阅档位才可用，且它生成的 DAX 要自己核对。
descEn: Microsoft's AI inside Power BI, generating reports and DAX from natural language.
caveatEn: Requires the right subscription tier, and the DAX it writes needs checking.

name: Tableau Pulse
desc: 自动监控指标变化并推送洞察，不用自己盯报表。
caveat: 偏指标监控推送，探索式分析能力弱于传统 BI 界面。
descEn: Monitors metric changes automatically and pushes insights instead of making you watch dashboards.
caveatEn: Focused on metric monitoring and alerts. Exploratory analysis is weaker than a traditional BI interface.

name: Luma Genie
desc: 文生 3D 模型，Luma 出品，风格统一、可交互预览。
caveat: 文生 3D 质量对提示词敏感，且导出的模型面数偏高。
descEn: Luma's text-to-3D model with consistent style and interactive preview.
caveatEn: Highly sensitive to prompt wording, and exported meshes carry a high polygon count.

name: Spline
desc: 浏览器里的 3D 设计工具，做网页 3D 交互最简单。
caveat: 网页 3D 交互友好，但做游戏资产不是它的场景。
descEn: 3D design in the browser — the simplest route to interactive 3D on a web page.
caveatEn: Great for web 3D interaction, but not a game asset pipeline.

name: Kaedim
desc: 2D 原画转 3D 模型，面向游戏美术流程，有专人质检。
caveat: 2D 转 3D 有专人质检，质量好但交付周期长、价格高。
descEn: Converts 2D concept art into 3D models for game art pipelines, with human quality control.
caveatEn: Human QC means good quality but long turnaround and high cost.

name: CSM
desc: 单张照片或视频重建 3D 场景，适合做数字孪生底图。
caveat: 场景重建适合数字孪生，但精细物体重建质量一般。
descEn: Reconstructs 3D scenes from a single photo or video, good for digital-twin basemaps.
caveatEn: Suited to scene reconstruction. Fine object reconstruction quality is average.

name: Alpha3D
desc: 2D 图片批量转 3D 资产，电商与虚拟试穿场景用得多。
caveat: 电商资产批量转换方便，但复杂结构的重建容易失败。
descEn: Batch-converts 2D images into 3D assets for e-commerce and virtual try-on.
caveatEn: Convenient for e-commerce assets, but complex structures often fail to reconstruct.

name: 腾讯混元 3D
desc: 腾讯开源的 3D 生成模型，从文生到贴图全链路。
caveat: 全链路开源，但推理需要一定显存，且贴图质量与商用方案仍有差距。
descEn: Tencent's open 3D generation model, covering the full chain from text to texture.
caveatEn: A full open pipeline, but inference needs meaningful VRAM and texture quality still trails commercial options.

name: Sloyd
desc: 参数化 3D 资产生成，拓扑规整、可直接进引擎。
caveat: 参数化生成拓扑规整，但资产风格偏程式化。
descEn: Parametric 3D asset generation with clean topology, ready to drop into an engine.
caveatEn: Topology is clean, but the asset style is noticeably formulaic.

name: TRELLIS
desc: 微软开源的结构化 3D 生成，输出质量接近商用方案。
caveat: 开源质量领先，但部署和调参需要一定研究能力。
descEn: Microsoft's open structured 3D generation — output quality close to commercial options.
caveatEn: Leading open quality, but deployment and tuning need real research capability.

name: Blender MCP
desc: 用 MCP 让 AI 直接操控 Blender 建模与调整场景。
caveat: 通过 MCP 操控 Blender，复杂建模任务仍不稳定，适合做重复性调整。
descEn: Uses MCP to let AI drive Blender directly for modelling and scene adjustments.
caveatEn: Complex modelling tasks remain unreliable. It's best for repetitive adjustments.

name: Tripo 3D 生成工作流
desc: 国产文生 3D 平台，支持多视图输入与自动绑定骨骼。
caveat: 骨骼绑定是亮点，但自动绑定的质量对模型姿势有要求。
descEn: Part of the Tripo workflow, adding multi-view input and automatic skeleton binding.
caveatEn: Automatic rigging is the highlight, but quality depends on the model's pose.

name: Jan
desc: 开源本地 AI 桌面客户端，界面像 ChatGPT 但完全离线。
caveat: 桌面客户端体验好，但生态和插件不如 Open WebUI 丰富。
descEn: An open-source local AI desktop client — a ChatGPT-like interface, fully offline.
caveatEn: Good desktop client, but its ecosystem and plugins are less rich than Open WebUI.

name: GPT4All
desc: 本地运行模型并支持对本地文档问答，纯离线。
caveat: 本地文档问答方便，但检索质量一般，正式场景建议换 RAG 框架。
descEn: Runs models locally and answers questions over your own documents, entirely offline.
caveatEn: Convenient for local document Q&A, but retrieval quality is average. For serious use, switch to a RAG framework.

name: AnythingLLM
desc: 一站式本地知识库，把文档、模型、向量库打包成一个桌面应用。
caveat: 一站式打包省事，但各部分都可替换时你未必需要它这层封装。
descEn: An all-in-one local knowledge base that packages documents, models and a vector store into one desktop app.
caveatEn: The all-in-one packaging saves time, but if you'd replace every component anyway, you may not need the wrapper.

name: Text Generation WebUI
desc: 老牌本地模型前端，功能最全、插件生态大。
caveat: 功能最全也最杂，配置项多到容易出问题，新手建议先用 Ollama。
descEn: The veteran local model frontend — the most complete feature set and the largest plugin ecosystem.
caveatEn: Most complete also means most cluttered. So many options that breakage is common; beginners should start with Ollama.

name: LocalAI
desc: 本地提供兼容 OpenAI 的 API，可直接替换现有代码。
caveat: 兼容 OpenAI 接口是优势，但性能和功能完整性弱于专门推理引擎。
descEn: Serves a local OpenAI-compatible API you can drop straight into existing code.
caveatEn: API compatibility is the advantage, but performance and feature completeness trail purpose-built inference engines.

name: SGLang
desc: 高吞吐推理框架，擅长多轮对话和结构化输出场景。
caveat: 吞吐高且擅长结构化输出，但生态和文档积累少于 vLLM。
descEn: A high-throughput inference framework, strong at multi-turn dialogue and structured output.
caveatEn: High throughput and good structured output, but less ecosystem and documentation than vLLM.

name: llamafile
desc: 把模型和运行时打包成一个可执行文件，双击就能跑。
caveat: 单文件分发很优雅，但性能不是它的目标，只适合轻量体验。
descEn: Packages model and runtime into a single executable file — double-click and it runs.
caveatEn: Elegant single-file distribution, but performance isn't the goal. Fine for light experimentation only.

name: Pinokio
desc: 一键安装各种开源 AI 应用的启动器，省掉环境配置。
caveat: 一键安装省去环境配置，但项目本身的质量参差不齐，要挑。
descEn: A one-click installer for open-source AI apps, skipping environment setup.
caveatEn: Saves setup pain, but project quality varies widely — be selective.

name: Xinference
desc: 国产开源模型推理与部署平台，多模型统一管理。
caveat: 多模型统一管理方便，国内硬件适配好，但社区案例少于 vLLM。
descEn: A Chinese open-source inference and deployment platform with unified multi-model management.
caveatEn: Convenient multi-model management and good domestic hardware support, but fewer community examples than vLLM.

name: LMDeploy
desc: 上海 AI Lab 的推理部署工具箱，国内硬件适配好。
caveat: 国产硬件适配是亮点，但主要面向 InternLM 系列，通用性略窄。
descEn: Shanghai AI Lab's inference and deployment toolkit, well adapted to domestic hardware.
caveatEn: Domestic hardware support is the highlight, but it's aimed mainly at the InternLM family — less general-purpose.

name: Ahrefs
desc: SEO 数据最全的工具之一，关键词与外链分析是核心。
caveat: 数据最全但价格高，个人站长用不起；且它的中文站数据覆盖不如英文站。
descEn: One of the most complete SEO datasets, built around keyword and backlink analysis.
caveatEn: The most complete data but priced accordingly — individual site owners can't justify it. Chinese-site coverage is also thinner than English.

name: Semrush
desc: SEO + 竞品 + 广告的综合营销工具箱。
caveat: 功能全但界面复杂，且同时覆盖 SEO 和广告意味着每一项都不是最深。
descEn: A combined SEO, competitor and advertising toolkit.
caveatEn: Comprehensive but the interface is complex, and covering both SEO and ads means being the deepest in neither.

name: Surfer SEO
desc: 按竞品内容结构给写作打分，做内容 SEO 的量化工具。
caveat: 内容评分是参考不是标准，完全按它打分写会产出「很 SEO 但没人读」的内容。
descEn: Scores your writing against competitor content structure — a way to quantify content SEO.
caveatEn: The score is a reference, not a standard. Writing purely to it produces content that ranks but nobody wants to read.

name: Buffer
desc: 多平台社媒排期发布，自带 AI 改写与配图建议。
caveat: 社媒排期成熟，但数据分析深度一般，需要深度洞察要配合专门工具。
descEn: Multi-platform social scheduling with AI rewriting and image suggestions.
caveatEn: Mature scheduling, but analytics depth is average — deep insight needs a dedicated tool.

name: Later
desc: 以图片社交为主，Instagram / 小红书类平台适配好。
caveat: 以图片社交为主，图文平台适配好，但短视频平台支持较弱。
descEn: Built around visual social platforms, with good Instagram and image-first support.
caveatEn: Image-first focus means weaker support for short-video platforms.

name: AdCreative.ai
desc: 批量生成广告素材并预测点击率，投放测试提效明显。
caveat: 批量生成素材方便，但创意同质化明显，长期投放容易疲劳。
descEn: Generates ad creatives in bulk and predicts click-through rates.
caveatEn: Bulk generation is convenient but creative homogeneity sets in, and long campaigns fatigue the audience.

name: Pencil
desc: 广告创意预测平台，上线前先估算胜出概率。
caveat: 预测胜率的参考价值有限，且它的训练数据主要来自特定平台的素材。
descEn: Predicts ad creative performance before you spend on media.
caveatEn: Predicted win rates are of limited value, and its training data comes mainly from specific platforms' creatives.

name: 巨量创意
desc: 字节官方的创意工具，抖音生态素材与脚本生产。
caveat: 字节官方工具，主要服务抖音生态，做其他平台价值有限。
descEn: ByteDance's official creative tool for producing Douyin-ecosystem assets and scripts.
caveatEn: A ByteDance tool serving the Douyin ecosystem, so limited value for other platforms.

name: 蝉妈妈
desc: 抖音电商数据与达人分析，选品和找达人前先查这里。
caveat: 抖音数据权威，但只看抖音；且核心数据在付费档位。
descEn: Douyin e-commerce data and creator analysis — check here before picking products or creators.
caveatEn: Authoritative for Douyin and Douyin only, with core data behind the paid tier.

name: 新榜
desc: 公众号与多平台内容数据榜，看选题趋势和爆款规律。
caveat: 公众号数据是强项，其他平台覆盖深度参差。
descEn: Content rankings across WeChat public accounts and other platforms — useful for spotting topic trends.
caveatEn: WeChat public accounts are the strength; coverage depth varies on other platforms.

name: Mailchimp
desc: 邮件营销老牌工具，自动化旅程和受众分层成熟。
caveat: 邮件营销老牌，但国内送达率和合规上与本土服务商有差距。
descEn: A long-standing email marketing tool with mature automation journeys and audience segmentation.
caveatEn: A veteran in email marketing, but deliverability and compliance in China lag behind domestic providers.

name: HubSpot
desc: CRM + 营销自动化一体，AI 助手可写邮件和总结客户记录。
caveat: 功能全面也意味着价格阶梯陡，小团队很容易为用不到的功能付费。
descEn: CRM and marketing automation in one, with AI that drafts emails and summarises customer records.
caveatEn: Comprehensive also means a steep pricing ladder. Small teams easily end up paying for features they never touch.

name: 飞书妙记
desc: 会议录音自动转文字并生成纪要，说话人分离准。
caveat: 转写质量依赖录音环境，多人抢话和强口音场景会明显下降。录音前要征得同意。
descEn: Automatic meeting transcription and minutes generation, with accurate speaker separation.
caveatEn: Transcription quality depends on the recording environment — multiple people talking over each other and heavy accents degrade it noticeably. Get consent before recording.

name: 腾讯会议 AI 小助手
desc: 会中实时纪要、会后待办提取，直接发到群里。
caveat: 绑定腾讯会议，且会中纪要在网络不稳时容易漏段。
descEn: Live minutes during a meeting and task extraction afterwards, posted straight into the group chat.
caveatEn: Bound to Tencent Meeting, and live minutes can drop segments when the connection is unstable.

name: 通义听悟
desc: 阿里音视频转写与摘要，长会议与课程录制都适用。
caveat: 长音视频处理强，但免费额度有限，且转写质量受音源影响大。
descEn: Alibaba's audio and video transcription and summarisation, good for long meetings and recorded lectures.
caveatEn: Strong on long audio and video, but the free quota is limited and quality depends heavily on the source audio.

name: 讯飞听见
desc: 科大讯飞转写，中文方言与专业词汇识别率高。
caveat: 中文方言识别率高，但实时性不如专门的会议助手。
descEn: iFlytek's transcription service with high accuracy on Chinese dialects and technical vocabulary.
caveatEn: High dialect accuracy, but real-time performance trails dedicated meeting assistants.

name: Otter.ai
desc: 英文会议转录标杆，自动识别说话人并生成待办。
caveat: 英文会议标杆，中文识别质量明显下降，国内团队慎选。
descEn: The benchmark for English meeting transcription, identifying speakers and generating action items.
caveatEn: The English benchmark, but Chinese recognition quality drops sharply — domestic teams should look elsewhere.

name: Fireflies.ai
desc: 自动加入会议录制并结构化，可搜索历史所有会议。
caveat: 自动加入会议需要授权，部分企业 IT 策略会拦截这类机器人。
descEn: Joins meetings automatically, records and structures them, and makes all history searchable.
caveatEn: The bot needs authorisation to join meetings, and some corporate IT policies block exactly this kind of bot.

name: tl;dv
desc: 录屏后自动打时间戳，回看时点摘要直接跳到那段。
caveat: 时间戳回看是亮点，但免费额度限制会议时长。
descEn: Timestamps recordings automatically so you can jump straight to the relevant moment from a summary.
caveatEn: Timestamped review is the highlight, but the free tier caps meeting length.

name: Granola
desc: 不录屏只记要点，把你的手写笔记和转录合并成纪要。
caveat: 不录屏是隐私友好的设计，代价是依赖你的手动笔记质量。
descEn: Records only key points rather than video, merging your handwritten notes with the transcript.
caveatEn: Not recording video is privacy-friendly, at the cost of depending on the quality of your own notes.

name: Fathom
desc: 免费额度大方的会议记录助手，个人版基本够用。
caveat: 免费额度大方，但深度分析和团队协作功能在付费档。
descEn: A meeting recorder with a generous free tier — the personal plan covers most individual use.
caveatEn: Generous free tier, but deep analytics and team collaboration sit behind the paid plan.

name: 钉钉 AI 助理
desc: 钉钉内置助理，会议纪要、待办、日程一体化。
caveat: 绑定钉钉生态，且会议记录涉及他人隐私，使用前要确认合规要求。
descEn: DingTalk's built-in assistant, unifying minutes, tasks and scheduling.
caveatEn: Tied to the DingTalk ecosystem, and meeting records involve other people's privacy — confirm compliance requirements first.

name: Khanmigo
desc: 可汗学院 AI 导师，不直接给答案而是引导你自己想出来。
caveat: 引导式教学不适合赶时间的人，且内容体系绑定可汗学院的课程。
descEn: Khan Academy's AI tutor. Doesn't hand over the answer — it guides you to work it out.
caveatEn: Guided teaching doesn't suit people in a hurry, and the content is bound to Khan Academy's curriculum.

name: Duolingo Max
desc: 多邻国 AI 版，可以和 AI 角色做真实场景对话练习。
caveat: AI 对话练习是增值项，但语言学习本身仍要靠持续投入。
descEn: Duolingo's AI tier, where you can hold realistic conversations with AI characters.
caveatEn: AI conversation is an add-on. Learning a language still depends on sustained effort from you.

name: Quizlet AI
desc: 上传资料自动生成闪卡与测验，备考复习效率高。
caveat: 闪卡适合记忆类知识，理解型内容用它效果有限。
descEn: Turns your material into flashcards and quizzes automatically — efficient for exam revision.
caveatEn: Flashcards suit memorisation. For conceptual understanding they help much less.

name: Socratic
desc: Google 出的解题助手，拍照提问，讲思路不讲答案。
caveat: 只讲思路不给答案，急需答案时会被它「绕」得着急。
descEn: Google's homework helper. Photograph a question and it explains the reasoning, not the answer.
caveatEn: Explains the approach without giving the answer, which is frustrating when you just need the answer quickly.

name: Photomath
desc: 拍数学题给出分步解法，题目覆盖到大学基础课。
caveat: 数学解题强，但复杂证明题的步骤解释仍可能出错。
descEn: Photograph a maths problem for a step-by-step solution, covering up to undergraduate foundation courses.
caveatEn: Strong on maths problems, but step explanations for complex proofs can still be wrong.

name: Gauth
desc: 字节的解题 App，多学科覆盖，中文题目支持好。
caveat: 多学科覆盖广，但每科的深度都有限，专业难题要另找资料。
descEn: ByteDance's solver app with broad subject coverage and good Chinese question support.
caveatEn: Broad subject coverage means shallow depth in each. Genuinely hard problems need other sources.

name: MagicSchool AI
desc: 给老师用的工具集：出题、写评语、做教案、分层作业。
caveat: 给老师用的工具集，学生直接用它意义不大。
descEn: A toolset for teachers: question generation, report comments, lesson plans and differentiated homework.
caveatEn: Built for teachers. Students using it directly won't get much.

name: Curipod
desc: 几分钟生成一节课的互动课件，含投票和开放题。
caveat: 课堂互动课件生成快，但内容深度依赖你的输入质量。
descEn: Generates an interactive lesson deck in minutes, including polls and open questions.
caveatEn: Generates classroom material quickly, but depth depends entirely on the quality of your input.

name: 学而思九章
desc: 好未来的数学大模型，讲题风格贴近国内教学体系。
caveat: 数学讲题贴合国内教学，但其他学科不是它的覆盖范围。
descEn: TAL's maths model, explaining problems in a style that fits the Chinese curriculum.
caveatEn: Explanations fit Chinese maths teaching, but other subjects are outside its scope.

name: 豆包爱学
desc: 字节的学习向助手，拍照讲题与作文批改免费。
caveat: 免费讲题与批改好用，但不要把它当权威答案——理科计算题务必自己复核。
descEn: ByteDance's learning assistant — photo-based problem explanation and essay marking, free.
caveatEn: Free and convenient, but don't treat it as an authority. Always re-check science and maths calculations yourself.

name: Gemini CLI / Antigravity CLI
desc: Google 的终端编程 Agent。开源、上下文大，是免费额度最慷慨的一档。
caveat: 2026-06-18 起 Google 把消费版入口迁到了新工具 Antigravity CLI —— 你现在装的可能是要换的那个。用之前先确认自己该用哪个。
descEn: Google's terminal coding agent. Open source, large context, and the most generous free tier in this category.
caveatEn: Since 18 Jun 2026 Google has been moving consumer access to a new tool called Antigravity CLI — the one you install today may not be the one you should. Check which you want first.

name: Grok Build
desc: xAI 的终端编程 Agent，可并行开多个子 Agent，上下文窗口是同类里最长的。
caveat: 目前只对 SuperGrok 高阶档开放，价格是同类里最贵的。并行开多个 Agent 的收益在复杂任务上才明显，日常改几个文件用不上。
descEn: xAI's terminal coding agent. Runs multiple parallel subagents, with the longest context window in this category.
caveatEn: Currently gated to the top SuperGrok tier and the priciest option here. Parallel subagents only pay off on complex work — overkill for editing a few files.

name: Qwen Code
desc: 阿里的开源终端编程 Agent，对接 Qwen 与任意兼容 OpenAI 协议的服务。
caveat: 定位是「模型无关」的壳，能力取决于你自己接哪个模型；接了小模型效果会明显打折。国内直连方便，但官方文档以英文为主。
descEn: Alibaba's open-source terminal agent, working with Qwen or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
caveatEn: A model-agnostic shell — quality depends entirely on what you plug in, and small models visibly disappoint. Convenient in China, but docs lean English.

name: OpenCode
desc: 开源终端 Agent，支持 75+ 家模型提供商，也能接本地模型。
caveat: 支持的提供商越多，配置项越多，第一次上手要花时间选模型和调参数。它不提供托管服务，模型费用要自己另外算。
descEn: Open-source terminal agent supporting 75+ providers, including local models.
caveatEn: More providers means more configuration — expect to spend time on model choice and parameters. No hosted offering, so model costs are separate.

name: Kilo CLI
desc: 开源多模型终端 Agent，能串起 CLI、VS Code、JetBrains 与云端任务。
caveat: 它的优势是「到处都能接」，如果你只用命令行或只用 IDE，这些额外集成就是多余的复杂度。平台本身免费，模型另计费。
descEn: Open-source multi-model terminal agent connecting CLI, VS Code, JetBrains and cloud tasks.
caveatEn: Its strength is reaching everywhere. If you only use the terminal or only an IDE, those extra integrations are needless complexity. The platform is free; models are billed separately.

name: Kimi Code CLI
desc: 月之暗面的开源终端编程 Agent，配合 Kimi 的开放权重模型使用。
caveat: 社区规模明显小于同类开源项目，遇到问题能找到的第三方资料少。「开源 + 可接自家模型」是卖点，但配套生态还在早期。
descEn: Moonshot's open-source terminal coding agent, built to pair with Kimi's open-weight models.
caveatEn: The community is markedly smaller than comparable open projects, so third-party troubleshooting material is scarce. Open source plus first-party models is the pitch, but the ecosystem is early.

name: WeKnora
desc: 腾讯开源的知识平台：文档 → 可检索 RAG → 会动手的 Agent → 自维护 Wiki。
caveat: 功能铺得很开（RAG / Agent / Wiki 三套），意味着部署与配置比单一用途方案重，团队要有运维能力。适合已有文档沉淀的场景，空手起家价值有限。
descEn: Tencent's open-source knowledge platform: documents into queryable RAG, an acting agent, and a self-maintaining wiki.
caveatEn: It spans three products (RAG, agent, wiki), so deployment and configuration are heavier than a single-purpose tool — your team needs ops capability. Best where documents already exist; less value from scratch.

name: mica-voice
desc: Java 生态的语音 AI 套件：一行代码接入识别、合成、声纹、降噪等七项能力。
caveat: 面向 Java 后端开发者，非 Java 技术栈基本用不上。它是封装层，底层跑的是通用的语音模型，效果取决于底层而非这个库本身。
descEn: A speech AI suite for the Java ecosystem: recognition, synthesis, voiceprint and denoising in one line of code.
caveatEn: Aimed at Java backend developers — useless outside that stack. It is a wrapper, so quality comes from the underlying speech models, not this library.

name: ZCode
desc: 智谱出品的桌面 AI 编程工具，对标 Claude Code，配 GLM 系列模型使用。
caveat: 2026-09 曾被曝登录后静默打包 .git 历史上传云端，引发信任风波；现已整改、开源并过第三方审计。对敏感项目仍建议先关代码库索引、盯紧权限。
descEn: Zhipu's desktop AI coding agent, positioned as a Claude Code counterpart and paired with the GLM model family.
caveatEn: In Sep 2026 it was caught silently uploading full .git history while signed in — since fixed, open-sourced and third-party audited. For sensitive repos, still disable repo indexing and watch permissions.

name: MiniMax Code CLI
desc: MiniMax 开源的终端编程智能体（MIT），支持 BYOK 接任意兼容模型的 API。
caveat: 工具本体开源免费，但算力按 MiniMax 套餐或自有 API 计费；评测数字（76.7%）来自第三方 30 题小样本，别当排行榜看。
descEn: MiniMax's open-source (MIT) terminal coding agent. BYOK-friendly: bring any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible API.
caveatEn: The tool is free and open, but compute bills through a MiniMax plan or your own API. Its 76.7% eval number comes from a small 30-task third-party run — not a leaderboard.
